'''István Szalay''' (22 March 1944 – 1 September 2022) was a Hungarian mathematician and politician. A member of the [[Hungarian Socialist Party]], he served in the [[National Assembly (Hungary)|National Assembly]] from 1998 to 2002.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.parlament.hu/egy-kepviselo-adatai?p_p_id=hu_parlament_cms_pair_portlet_PairProxy_INSTANCE_9xd2Wc9jP4z8&p_p_lifecycle=1&p_p_state=normal&_hu_parlament_cms_pair_portlet_PairProxy_INSTANCE_9xd2Wc9jP4z8_pairAction=%2Finternet%2Fcplsql%2Fogy_kpv.kepv_adat%3Fp_azon%3Ds026|title=Dr. Szalay István|work=National Assembly|language=Hungarian}}</ref> Prior to that, he was mayor of [[Szeged]] from 1994 to 1998.

Szalay died on 1 September 2022, at the age of 78.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=2 September 2022|title=Tragikus hírtelenséggel elhunyt Dr. Szalay István, Szeged egykori polgármestere|trans-title= |url=https://webradio.hu/hirek/belfold/tragikus-hirtelenseggel-elhunyt-dr-szalay-istvan-szeged-egykori-polgarmestere|language=Hungarian|work=WEBradio.hu|location= |access-date=2 September 2022}}</ref>
